scope: No native launch, credential access, build, release, or product-case retest. Diagnosis of hosted run 37708712354 against its frozen CI artifact and current-run evidence.

verified_boundary.first_failure: BROWSER_STARTUP_FAILURE: owned_cdp_endpoint_timeout at native:cdp_connect, before any audit case; the owned profile's DevToolsActivePort was absent at the existing 5000 ms deadline.
verified_boundary.log_observation: The actual run log reports spawnObserved=true, launchFailed=false, child exitCode=null and signalCode=null, stderrFlags.hadStderr=false, 149 ENOENT polls over 5010 ms, longestReadMs=81. These fields do not prove the child remained alive throughout or why no endpoint appeared.
verified_boundary.resource_order: RESOURCE_CPU_PENDING at 00:44:01.688Z with cpuBusyFraction=0.92 followed BROWSER_STARTUP_FAILURE at 00:43:59.912Z by about 1.78 s. Process attribution at 00:44:01.834Z shows Chromium PID 23522 at 95.6% plus Chromium Helpers, but is a later snapshot. Guest child exited 1; guard finalized resourceInvalid=true and wrapper exit 3. Package and browser setup journals finalized valid.
verified_boundary.product_verdict: No audit cases reached and no EXT-D-0159 or T27/T61/T62/T86 acceptance credit. CPU invalidation is a guard verdict, not a product failure.

source_boundary.connector: tests/browser/vault-owned-cdp.cjs connectOwnedCdp polls DevToolsActivePort every 25 ms and throws after a 5000 ms default; read errors other than ENOENT use a different failure code. No endpoint record, lock-owner check, WebSocket attempt, extension discovery, or admin sign-in was reached.
source_boundary.launcher: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs creates a fresh owned profile, spawns full Chromium with remote-debugging-port=0, and immediately calls connectOwnedCdp. Audit calls it with headed=true. The SEO guest comparator uses the default headed=false and adds --headless=new.
source_boundary.same_artifact_comparator: Intel SEO run 37708611887 used the same checkout and frozen artifact, reached BROWSER_PANEL_CONTEXT_READY, completed bounded guest clipboard cases, and had a valid resource journal. This excludes a deterministic artifact or universal Intel Chromium failure, but does not isolate headed mode from host scheduling, fixture, or run timing.
source_boundary.arm_comparator: ARM audit run 37706132089 reached BROWSER_PANEL_CONTEXT_READY and AUDIT_NATIVE_RESULT pass before its own resource-invalid guard decision. The audit path can reach cases on another host; it does not prove Intel headed startup reliability.

ranked_uncertainty.hypothesis: Cold headed Chromium startup on this Intel host exceeded the fixed endpoint wait while Chromium was busy initializing.
ranked_uncertainty.prediction: A bounded observation that leaves the existing guard and launch unchanged would see the owned endpoint appear after 5 seconds, before the child stops, with a later successful CDP attach if a separate diagnostic were permitted.
ranked_uncertainty.limit: The run ended at the five-second boundary; endpoint creation after it was not observed. Later high CPU is compatible but not causal proof.

ranked_uncertainty.hypothesis: The headed Chromium child stalled in macOS display or GPU startup and never published the endpoint.
ranked_uncertainty.prediction: A guard-owned startup observation would show no endpoint through the admitted interval and a persistent child, or a classified child exit/stderr event before shutdown.
ranked_uncertainty.limit: The safe stderr flags were all false and the child had no observed exit at timeout; neither identifies a display/GPU fault.

ranked_uncertainty.hypothesis: A transient host scheduling spike delayed the harness or Chromium independently of headed mode.
ranked_uncertainty.prediction: Repeated fresh Intel runs under identical startup parameters would vary with measured host scheduling; endpoint timing would correlate with per-host load rather than audit content.
ranked_uncertainty.limit: One failed audit and one successful headless SEO run cannot estimate that correlation; 149 polls indicate the harness did run during the five seconds.

next_executable_move: No source repair is justified. If a new hosted diagnostic attempt is authorized, instrument only the existing owned Chrome startup boundary to record bounded endpoint-exists time, child exit state and classified stderr flags through the already guarded interval on macos-15-intel, using the exact frozen artifact and headed audit launch parameters. Preserve the current resource thresholds and stop on its decision. An ARM-only startup-resource-diagnostic is already available, but it cannot discriminate this Intel headed failure without a source change. Do not increase the timeout or retry acceptance as a causal fix before that observation.
